literal_meaning: একই এবং অদ্বিতীয় (one only, without a second)
figurative_meaning_bn: এক ও অনন্য; তুলনারহিত; যার তুলনা নাই
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই স্থানটি একমেব অদ্বিতীয়ম সৌন্দর্যের জন্য বিখ্যাত।
example_sentences_in_english: Her talent is one and only.
This place is famous for its incomparable beauty.
history: Derived from Sanskrit Vedanta philosophy, referring to the supreme reality (Brahman) as the one without a second, as in the Chandogya Upanishad.
note: Often used in formal or literary Bengali to denote absolute uniqueness.
